title: Colocalisation analysis with run_coloc()
text: prior probabilities SNP associated trait 1 (p1), trait 2 (p2), traits (p12). defaults (p1 = 1e-4, p2 = 1e-4, p12 = 1e-5) coloc package reasonable GWAS-vs-GWAS comparisons. change : ratio p12 / p1 (equivalently p12 / p2) encodes prior belief likely two traits share causal variant, given least one associated. default ratio 0.1 — .e., SNP causal trait 1, 10% prior chance also causal trait 2. traits expect share biology (e.g. two psychiatric disorders), increase p12 toward 1e-4 (ratio ~1). traits little expected overlap (e.g. metabolite vs. behavioural trait), defaults fine decrease p12 1e-6. coloc::sensitivity() can used check sensitive results choice priors.
code: # Stronger prior for shared causality result <- run_coloc(..., p12 = 5e-5)  # Check sensitivity to prior choice coloc::sensitivity(result, rule = "H4 > 0.8")

title: Getting started with downstreamGWAS
text: Running method like SBayesRC summary statistics typically requires: Munging — reformatting columns, filtering variants, computing effective N Reference data — LD matrices, annotation files, gene lists Software — installing tools may conflict HPC environment Scheduling — writing SLURM scripts correct paths resource requests step error-prone rarely reusable across methods datasets.

title: downstreamGWAS Roadmap
text: Make downstream GWAS analysis reproducible low-friction standardizing input contracts, containerized execution, reference data management, HPC scheduling.

title: downstreamGWAS Roadmap
text: One canonical input: tidyGWAS format accepted input. Consistent pipeline contract: every pipeline_*() function follows interface. Script-first: generate inspectable bash scripts; execution opt-. HPC-first: SLURM scheduling Apptainer containers first-class. Preflight validation: fail fast clear errors wasting compute.

title: downstreamGWAS Roadmap
text: pipeline_*() functions share: Implemented pipelines: pipeline_clumping(), pipeline_sbayesrc(), pipeline_sbayess().
code: pipeline_<method>(   parent_dir,   output_dir = NULL,        # defaults to <parent_dir>/analysis/<method>   write_script = TRUE,   execute = FALSE,   schedule = NULL,           # schedule_slurm(...) for SLURM submission   prepare_inputs = execute,  # include data conversion step in script   check_paths = TRUE,        # validate assets before execution   ...                        # method-specific parameters )

title: downstreamGWAS Roadmap
text: setup_dsg() — one-time config setup, creates ~/.config/downstreamGWAS/config.yml dsg_get_config() — reads merged config (package defaults + user overrides) dsg_build_apptainer_exec() — single function container command generation dsg_script_preamble() — bash header optional SLURM directives dsg_finalize_pipeline() — shared write/execute/return logic schedule_slurm() — typed schedule object Preflight checks: dsg_check_parent_dir(), dsg_check_writable_dir(), dsg_check_*_assets()

title: downstreamGWAS Roadmap
text: Two-layer model: Package defaults (inst/extdata/params.yml): container filenames, reference relative paths, mount points User config (~/.config/downstreamGWAS/config.yml): storage_root, reference_dir, container_dir, container_dependency

title: downstreamGWAS Roadmap
text: Unit tests script generation — validates correct commands, SLURM headers, container dependency injection, output paths, prepare_inputs toggling. mocking apptainer SLURM; tests verify generated bash, execution.

title: downstreamGWAS Roadmap
text: run_coloc() / format_coloc() — colocalisation via coloc::coloc.abf() mr_on_tidyGWAS() — two-sample MR via TwoSampleMR Export functions: to_ma(), to_clumping(), to_ldsc()

title: downstreamGWAS Roadmap
text: Problem: Reference files large (10-100GB), hosted across Zenodo external sources, nothing verifies ’s disk correct. truncated download, wrong version, misnamed directory silently produces wrong results. Deliverables: inst/extdata/references.yml — manifest mapping method required files expected checksums (sha256), file sizes, source URLs, build/ancestry tags. dsg_verify_references(method = NULL) — checks files disk manifest. Reports missing, truncated (size mismatch), wrong (checksum mismatch) files. Runs -demand, every pipeline call. dsg_reference_status() — summary ’s present ’s missing, methods specific one. Document download instructions per method. self-hosted files (Zenodo), provide direct URLs. externally-hosted files, document exact version source. Accept mixed model — pin can, document can’t. scope: automated download functions multi-GB files. documented wget curl command practical R.

title: downstreamGWAS Roadmap
text: Problem: params.yml uses _latest container tags. ’s record ’s inside container, upstream changes can silently break things. Deliverables: Move Dockerfiles inst/docker/ repo records exactly container contains. Tag containers dates version numbers instead _latest (e.g. sbayesrc_2024-06.sif). Update params.yml accordingly. Add CI job (documented manual step) builds containers runs smoke test (e.g. apptainer exec image.sif R -e "library(SBayesRC)").

title: downstreamGWAS Roadmap
text: Migrate old run_*() wrappers pipeline_*() contract: pipeline_ldsc() — LD score regression (h2, rg) pipeline_sldsc() — stratified LDSC / cell-type analysis pipeline_mbat_combo() — mBAT-combo gene test pipeline_coloc() — wrap run_coloc() script generation batch use migration follows pattern: extract container command construction, use dsg_build_apptainer_exec(), add preflight checks, use dsg_finalize_pipeline().

title: downstreamGWAS Roadmap
text: Problem: Unit tests verify script generation actual execution. gap “script looks correct” “script runs correctly” real failures happen. Deliverables: small test dataset (subset tidyGWAS output, ~1000 variants) committed inst/testdata/ hosted Zenodo. integration test script (testthat — meant run manually HPC) exercises full path: setup_dsg() → pipeline_sbayesrc() → verify output file exists non-empty. Document expected resource requirements runtime integration test.

title: downstreamGWAS Roadmap
text: pipeline run writes run_manifest.json alongside results, recording: parameters used, container path, reference versions, generated script, timestamps. valuable reproducibility blocking — generated .sh script already captures information.

title: downstreamGWAS Roadmap
text: Dataset abstraction (dataset_open(), dataset_validate()): tidyGWAS directory dataset. Adding wrapper object doesn’t buy much dsg_check_parent_dir(). Method spec contract (method_prepare_*, method_run_*, method_parse_*): -engineering 5-10 methods maintained one person. pipeline_*() contract concrete sufficient. Runtime adapter abstraction (apptainer vs singularity): dsg_build_apptainer_exec() handles . Singularity effectively dead; abstracting runtimes adds complexity practical benefit. Orchestration layer (plan_analysis(), DAG execution): premature. current pattern calling pipeline_*() loop script adequate. Revisit /20+ methods complex dependencies. Automated reference downloads R: multi-GB downloads better handled shell commands. R’s download facilities unreliable large files.

title: downstreamGWAS Roadmap
text: new user can go install_github() running SBayesRC cluster 30 minutes (including reference data download). dsg_verify_references() catches wrong/missing/truncated files cause silent failures. Adding new pipeline method requires method-specific code — plumbing changes. Generated scripts self-contained runnable without R.
